controls.name: identity bypass
controls.role: Unprocessed input is the matched control; a correction must be compared against it before any benefit is claimed.

controls.name: frozen analytic biquad response
controls.role: High-pass and notch outputs are compared against an analytic double-precision reference waveform, not against themselves.

controls.name: energy-matched scalar-only gain
controls.role: Equalizes output energy without spectral redistribution so a tilt result cannot pass as a level effect.

controls.name: deliberate level confound
controls.role: A +1 dB unmatched scalar control must be detected as a confound, not accepted as tonal correction.

controls.name: missing clean reference not scored
controls.role: A missing reference is recorded as missing and cannot qualify the candidate.

controls.name: DC and rumble attenuation versus speech-band preservation
controls.role: Low-frequency rejection and wanted-band preservation are reported as separate outcomes.

controls.name: near-clip and soft-clip interaction
controls.role: Near-unity peaks, pre-clipped input and a tilt-tanh-tilt cascade expose headroom and nonlinear risk.

controls.name: ill-conditioned out-of-band amplification
controls.role: Clustered probes and out-of-band noise amplification are reported as explicitly non-qualifying.

controls.name: matched-gain split-band versus broadband attenuation
controls.role: The de-esser is compared with the same per-sample gains applied broadband so low-band preservation is visible.

controls.name: synthetic and predicted-only separation
controls.role: Synthetic fixtures and response measurements are labelled as such; no listening, real-speech or device claim is inherited.
